style: Realistic documentary photograph of a small Norwegian trade business at work, natural Nordic daylight, muted natural colours, clean and tidy, honest everyday working conditions, believable modern Scandinavian homes and workshops, shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens, shallow depth of field.
